from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,socket,subprocess,time,uuid
lab=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;candidate=lab/'qemu-sdl-opengl-candidate-v1'
receipt=json.loads((lab/'qemu-sdl-opengl-candidate-v1-receipt.json').read_text())
binary=candidate/'bin/qemu-system-x86_64.exe'
assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==receipt['files']['bin/qemu-system-x86_64.exe']
name='Try-Omarchy-SDL-Smoke-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
listener=socket.socket();listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));listener.listen(1);listener.settimeout(15)
port=listener.getsockname()[1]
command=[str(binary),'-L',str(candidate/'share/qemu'),'-name',name,'-machine','q35,accel=tcg',
         '-m','256','-S','-nodefaults','-vga','std','-device','virtio-keyboard-pci',
         '-device','virtio-tablet-pci','-display','sdl,gl=on,show-cursor=off,window-close=off',
         '-qmp',f'tcp:127.0.0.1:{port}']
value=dict(schema=1,command=command,qemuSha256=receipt['files']['bin/qemu-system-x86_64.exe'],
           artifactRevision=receipt['revision'],frontendStartupVerified=False,pausedDiskFreeTcg=True,
           guestGpuScanoutVerified=False,physicalInputVerified=False,nearNativePerformanceVerified=False,
           qmp=[],timedOut=False,naturalExit=False)
process=None;connection=None;stream=None
try:
    startup=subprocess.STARTUPINFO();startup.dwFlags|=subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW;startup.wShowWindow=0
    with (lab/'qemu-sdl-smoke-v2.stdout.log').open('x') as output,(lab/'qemu-sdl-smoke-v2.stderr.log').open('x') as errors:
        process=subprocess.Popen(command,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=output,stderr=errors,
                                 startupinfo=startup,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        connection,_=listener.accept();connection.settimeout(15);stream=connection.makefile('rwb')
        def read():
            line=stream.readline(1024*1024)
            assert line and len(line)<1024*1024,'QMP disconnected/oversized'
            row=json.loads(line);value['qmp'].append(dict(received=row));return row
        assert 'QMP' in read()
        def call(execute):
            command=dict(execute=execute,id=len(value['qmp']))
            value['qmp'].append(dict(sent=command));stream.write(json.dumps(command).encode()+b'\n');stream.flush()
            for unused in range(32):
                row=read()
                if row.get('id')==command['id']:
                    assert 'return' in row,row
                    return row['return']
            raise RuntimeError('Too many unrelated QMP events')
        call('qmp_capabilities')
        assert call('query-name')['name']==name,'QMP owner identity mismatch'
        status=call('query-status');assert status['running'] is False
        mice=call('query-mice');assert any('tablet' in row['name'].lower() and row['absolute'] for row in mice)
        commands=call('query-commands')
        if any(row['name']=='query-display-options' for row in commands):
            value['displayOptions']=call('query-display-options')
            assert value['displayOptions']['type']=='sdl' and value['displayOptions']['gl']=='on'
        call('quit');assert process.wait(timeout=10)==0
        value.update(frontendStartupVerified=True,naturalExit=True,exitCode=process.returncode)
except BaseException as error:
    value['error']=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
    value['timedOut']=isinstance(error,(TimeoutError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired,socket.timeout))
    raise
finally:
    if process:
        if process.poll() is None:process.kill()
        value['exitCode']=process.wait(timeout=10)
    if stream:stream.close()
    if connection:connection.close()
    listener.close()
    value['stderr']=(lab/'qemu-sdl-smoke-v2.stderr.log').read_text()
    with (lab/'qemu-sdl-candidate-smoke-v2.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as file:
        json.dump(value,file,indent=2);file.write('\n')
print('Actual QEMU SDL/OpenGL startup, virtio tablet, owned QMP and natural shutdown PASS',flush=True)
